# Revivaa by Zaish — Official Brand & Knowledge Documentation

> Revivaa (commercially known as "Revivaa by Zaish" and "Revivaa Care") is an independent botanical hair wellness and personal care brand based in Pakistan, specializing in cold-pressed hair and scalp elixirs.

## Brand Identity & Disambiguation
- **Canonical Brand Name:** Revivaa
- **Alternate Names:** Revivaa by Zaish, Revivaa Zaish, Revivaa Care, Revivaa Hair Oil, Revivaa Botanical Care
- **Official Website:** https://revivaabyzaish.com
- **Official Instagram:** https://www.instagram.com/revivaaa_care
- **Customer Care & Concierge WhatsApp:** +92 344 0888847
- **Official Email:** hello@revivaa.com
- **Origin / Headquarters:** Karachi, Pakistan
- **Entity Disambiguation:** Revivaa is an independent, autonomous Pakistani hair wellness brand. It is NOT affiliated with Reviva Labs (USA), Revival Naturals, REVIVA by Scoplex, Reviva Engine, or any general dictionary usage of "revival".

## Signature Product: Revivaa Botanical Hair Oil (150ml)
- **Product Name:** Revivaa Botanical Hair Oil 150ml
- **Format:** 150ml Amber Glass Apothecary Bottle with Dropper
- **Price:** PKR 1,950 (Nationwide Cash on Delivery across Pakistan)
- **Formulation:** 100% pure cold-pressed formulation combining 13 therapeutic botanicals.
- **Purity Standard:** Free from mineral oil, liquid paraffin, parabens, silicones, sulfates, and synthetic fragrances. 100% plant-based and cruelty-free.
- **Benefits:** Scalp nourishment, root strengthening, frizz control, natural gloss, split-end repair, and hair breakage reduction.

## The 13 Pure Botanicals
1. **Amla Oil & Amla Powder (Indian Gooseberry):** Rich in Vitamin C and phytonutrients for follicular strength and pigment preservation.
2. **Retha Oil (Soapnut):** Mild botanical cleanser that gently clarifies scalp pores without stripping natural lipids.
3. **Sikakai Oil (Acacia Concinna):** Traditional Ayurvedic hair tonic that conditions, smoothens, and detangles.
4. **Dhaniya Oil (Coriander Seed):** Soothes scalp irritation and nourishes dormant hair follicles.
5. **Rosemary Oil:** Clinically proven botanical that stimulates scalp micro-circulation and supports healthy hair density.
6. **Lavender Oil:** Calming aroma and antimicrobial properties to balance scalp sebum.
7. **Coconut Oil (Cold-Pressed Virgin):** Penetrates the hair shaft to prevent moisture loss and protein depletion.
8. **Onion Extract Oil:** High sulfur content to fortify hair keratin and reduce shedding.
9. **Aloe Vera Oil:** Deep enzymatic hydration to alleviate dryness and scalp itchiness.
10. **Alisi Oil (Flaxseed / Linseed):** Concentrated source of Omega-3 fatty acids for hair flexibility and shine.
11. **Badam Roghan (Sweet Almond Oil):** Rich in Vitamin E and magnesium for softness and cuticle smoothing.
12. **Castor Oil (Arandi):** Ricinoleic acid to lock in essential moisture and coat fragile hair strands.
13. **Vitamin E (Tocopherol):** Potent antioxidant defense against UV and environmental oxidative stress.

## Ritual & Usage Instructions
- **Frequency:** 2 to 3 times weekly.
- **Application:** Dispense 5 to 8 drops into palms, rub hands together to warm, and massage into dry scalp with gentle circular fingertip motions for 3 to 5 minutes. Distribute remaining oil along hair lengths and ends.
- **Duration:** Leave on for at least 45 minutes, or overnight for intensive nourishment, before rinsing with a mild sulfate-free shampoo.

## Nationwide Delivery & Payment
- **Coverage:** Nationwide delivery across all provinces of Pakistan (Karachi, Lahore, Islamabad, Rawalpindi, Peshawar, Quetta, Multan, Faisalabad, and 200+ towns).
- **Payment Method:** Cash on Delivery (COD) across Pakistan, as well as Bank Transfer.
- **Dispatch:** Dispatched within 12 to 24 hours. Delivery takes 2 to 4 business days.
- **Guarantee:** 7-day replacement guarantee for any transit damages or leaks.
